hints.meaning: This tool performs no side-effect state changes.
Calling this tool repeatedly with the same arguments produces the same result.
This tool may interact with external entities outside the MCP server's control.
This tool may perform destructive updates (deletes, overwrites, etc.).

explicit_declaration_rule: Every registered tool declares readOnlyHint explicitly rather than relying on a default. Downstream consumers (for example symaira-brain's foreign-tool exposure policy) read a missing readOnlyHint as "write", the least-trusted classification — silence is not neutral, it is the worst case.
